description: Allowed-input manifest whose input entry carries a revision commit SHA that does not exist in the repository. The immutable source binding MUST reject this with ALLOWED_INPUT_REVISION_UNREACHABLE; an unreachable commit cannot be an authoritative source for bytes.

allowed_inputs_record.description: A manifest whose input entry supplies a revision that is not reachable from any Git ref. The validator must surface this as an unreachable-revision failure.
